name: plan-tour-route
description: Plan a multi-stop tour route with waypoint optimization, drive/walk time estimation, and POI discovery along the route using OSM data. Covers geocoding, nearest-neighbor and TSP-based ordering, time/distance matrix calculation, and itinerary generation with points of interest. Use when planning a road trip or walking tour with multiple destinations, optimizing visit order to minimize travel time, discovering sites along a route, or comparing driving versus walking versus public transport options.
